item.title: Japan
item.description:
Brief Summary

One of the most memorable trips, slow pace, revisiting our favorite places and discovering new ones we haven’t before.

Yokohama

  • Waterfront

  • Cup noodle museum

  • Leonard’s donuts

  • Visit to passenger ship

  • Chinatown

  • Nice shopping street

  • Another shopping street

Fujiyoshida

  • Five story pagoda

  • Sushi conveyor restaurant

  • FabCafe

  • Five lakes

  • Jazz bar

Tokyo

  • Ginza: Luxury shopping and dining; features Grand Seiko, Chanel, Uniqlo flagship, and Kabuki-za Theatre.

  • Harajuku: Trendy street fashion, Takeshita Street, Fender flagship store; close to Meiji Shrine.

  • Ikebukuro: Shopping, anime culture, and transport hub with a local Tokyo atmosphere.

  • Nihonbashi: Historic financial center with traditional shops and department stores like Mitsukoshi and Maruzen for quality Japanese books and stationery.

  • Shibuya: Youth culture, fashion, and entertainment.

  • Shinjuku: Business district with nightlife and skyscrapers.

  • Ueno: Cultural hub with Ueno Park, museums, zoo, and Yoshimi-dōri Avenue’s restaurants and shops near Ueno Station.

Miscellaneous Notes

  • Travel dates: 2025-09-28 — 2025-10-14

  • Airline: ANA to Haneda International Airport

  • Transportation: Trains using the Welcome Suica Card and Highway Bus

  • Hotels: Hotel Mystays, Yokohama, Fujiyoshida Hostel, Mt. Fuji, Dormy Inn Ikebukuro

item.title: Whistler
item.description:
Brief Summary

We had an amazing hiking trip up to Whistler.

Miscellaneous Notes

Travel dates: 2025-08-26 - 2025-08-28

Hotel: Pangea Pod Hotel ($273.32 for 2 nights).

First things first, we stopped by Britannia Village to check out the new housing and retail stores, opened late August 2025. There is a very nice bakery.

Next, we headed to Squamish and the tourist centre. There’s some new housing at the south end of Squamish, and it looks pretty good but is a dense area.

After that, we grabbed a pizza at Function Junction. It was okay, and shared a carrot cake at the original Pure Bread location in Function Junction. We learned all about the history of the place. The bakery has been acquired for $10.2 million by Coho Collective Kitchens Inc., the Vancouver-based food technology and commercial real estate company that provides private and shared kitchen and food production space to a variety of businesses.

Our pod hotel was clean and comfortable.

For dinner, we went to Hunter Gather in Whistler Village. They had a very good brisket. After dinner, we bought gondola tickets ($210 per day for the two of us).

We hiked the High Note trail (9.5 km). It was a bit of a challenge, but the scenery was amazing. Unfortunately, due to lighting, everybody had to come down. Peak 2 Peak was already canceled, so that was a bummer.

We had breakfast at Provisions in Whistler Village for a croissant (excellent) and a blueberry muffin. We learned that Toptable Group owns Provisions, Araxi, Bar Oso, Il Caminetto, Blue Water Cafe, Thierry, and many other high-end restaurants.

We walked to Upper Village and had a coffee at % Arabica after back in Whistler Village. It was a new café for us, seemingly Japanese, but the coffee was sweet.

We drove to Lost Lake and Rainbow Park, very nice by Alta Lake.

We bought The Beer Farmers’ lager and white beer, and sourdough bread from the BReD organic sourdough bakery at Whistler Creekside Village.

We arrived home safely before dark, feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. It was a wonderful hiking trip.

item.title: Italy
item.description:
Brief Summary

A wonderful trip through the beautiful cities of Verona, Venice, Florence, Siena, and Bologna, focused on culture, history, and food. The itinerary includes iconic landmarks, local markets, and authentic Italian experiences.

Itinerary Overview

  • 25–28 June: Verona
    • Juliet’s House & Balcony
    • Verona Arena & La Traviata, the most performed opera in the world
    • Piazza delle Erbe
    • Castelvecchio & Bridge
  • 28 June – 01 July: Venice
    • St. Mark’s Basilica & Square
    • Grand Canal & Vaporetto ride
    • Doge’s Palace
    • Islands visits
  • 01–05 July: Florence
    • Florence Cathedral (Duomo) & Giotto’s Campanile
    • David statue
    • Ponte Vecchio
  • 05–10 July: Siena
    • Piazza del Campo (Palio di Siena location)
    • Siena Cathedral (Duomo di Siena)
    • Torre del Mangia
    • Tuscan countryside day trips
  • 10–13 July: Bologna
    • Piazza Maggiore & Basilica di San Petronio
    • Asinelli and Garisenda Towers
    • Traditional Bolognese cuisine (tagliatelle al ragù)
    • Archiginnasio of Bologna (historic university library)

item.description:
Brief Summary

A wonderful vacation, relaxing and exciting. In the Pacific, relaxation was easy. And seeing wildlife, it was quite exciting: manta rays, dolphins, turtles, and wild goats roaming the lava fields. The black pepper plant and cocoa juice, made from cocoa seed pulp, were unforgettable.

Miscellaneous Notes

item.title: Canadian Rockies
item.description:
Brief Summary

A short road trip to the Canadian Rockies which includes a visit to the town of Banff, a ride along the Icefields Parkway, and a stop at Lake Louise is a perfect way to experience the stunning natural beauty of this region. Many memorable sights, from the turquoise waters of Lake Louise to the towering peaks of the surrounding mountains. We also visited Barkerville, a historic mining town in British Columbia, which provided a fascinating glimpse into the Gold Rush era.

Miscellaneous Notes

  • Travel dates: 2023-06-26 - 2023-07-06

  • Transportation: 2012 Electra & 2018 Suzili
